subject: Discovery follow-up / scheduling technical deep dive - rotating slots
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aperture.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@aperture.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up / scheduling technical deep dive - rotating slots

Hi Emma / Liam —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier — really appreciated the openness about Aperture's inference pain points and the volume/latency targets. Quick recap:
- Primary use case: multi-tenant document search + summarization for fraud investigations
- Typical request profile: 1-3k tokens per session, bursty peak during audit windows
- Key constraints: predictable tail latency, strict data isolation, and SOC2 evidence

Next step: we'd love to schedule a 60-90 minute technical deep dive (SE + infra) to walk through architecture, latency budgets, and a simple demo of how Redwood handles prefix caching and model fallbacks. Aditya (copied) would drive that session.

Because your team spans the US, EU, and APAC, I wanted to propose a rotating meeting pattern so we share the pain of late/early times fairly — happy to adjust based on what your team prefers. Proposed rotation (weekly):
- Slot A (US-friendly week): Mon 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / Tue 01:00 SGT
- Slot B (EU-friendly week): Wed 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / Thu 03:00 SGT
- Slot C (APAC-friendly week): Fri 15:00 PT / Sat 00:00 CET / Sat 08:00 SGT

If rotation is too complex, we can pick a fixed weekly time that hits the majority. Can you confirm:
1) Which of the three rotation slots would work for your core attendees (security, infra, product)?
2) Are there any blackout windows (e.g., weekly incident review Fri 15:30 CET)?
3) Any materials you'd like us to prep (e.g., dataset samples, sample model sizes)?

Attached: MAP-Aperture-v1.pdf (mutual action plan) and Aperture-usage-metrics.xlsx.

If it's helpful I'll drop a tentative calendar invite for the first session and set it as "rotating weekly" so we can adjust after one or two runs.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aperture.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@aperture.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up / scheduling technical deep dive - rotating slots

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the rotation proposal — that looks thoughtful and I like the fairness of rotating. A few quick notes from our side:
- Core attendees: me (product), Liam (infra lead), and one security engineer (Tereza Novak) — Tereza is based in Prague (CET) and prefers morning CET slots when possible.
- Blackouts: we have a weekly incident review Tuesdays 14:00-15:30 CET.

Availability for next two weeks (all times local to each attendee):
- Mon 2026-11-30: Emma available 16:00-18:30 CET; Liam 15:00-17:00 CET; Tereza only 09:00-11:00 CET
- Wed 2026-12-02: Emma 09:00-12:00 CET; Liam 08:00-11:00 CET; Tereza 09:00-12:30 CET

If we do the rotation, Week A or Week B would work for us — Week C's APAC-friendly Fri slot will be difficult.

Also can Aditya run through expected deployment topologies (hosted vs. private) and any sample latency numbers for 2k token prompts? If you can attach a short one-pager that'd be great.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones
VP Product | Aperture Analytics
emma.jones@aperture.ai | +44 20 7946 0832

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@aperture.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 18:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up / scheduling technical deep dive - rotating slots

Hi Emma / Marissa —

Happy to join. Quick notes on what I can present in the technical deep dive:
- Redwood deployment options: hosted API, Dedicated reserved pools (SLA-backed), Private VPC appliance.
- Typical latency numbers (2k tokens): 95th percentile ranges from ~120-350ms per token depending on model size and quantization; we'll surface per-model perf profiles for similar workloads.
- Key topics I want to cover: prefix/KV cache behavior during bursts, autoscaling / warm-pool strategy, model fallback policies, and an architecture sketch for private deployments with KMS/HSM integration.

For the session, it helps to know:
- expected QPS during peak audit windows
- whether you need strict tenant isolation (VM-level / physical isolation) or logical isolation is fine
- sample input sizes and any long-context examples

My availability next week (PT): Mon 08:00-12:00 PT, Wed 10:00-16:00 PT, Fri 14:00-18:00 PT. I can align to the rotation as needed.

I'll prep a 2-slide one-pager on deployment options and a perf snapshot — will attach before the call.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aperture.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@aperture.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up / scheduling technical deep dive - rotating slots

Great — thanks all for quick replies.

Based on availability, here's a proposed plan:
1) Kickoff deep dive: Wed 2026-12-02 10:00 PT / 19:00 CET / Thu 03:00 SGT (Week B slot) — 75 minutes.
   - Agenda: 15m intros & goals, 25m architecture & deployment patterns (Aditya), 20m demo & perf snapshot, 15m next steps + MAP review.
2) Recurring rhythm: start with weekly rotation but defer to a fixed cadence after 4 runs if it's too disruptive.
3) I'll create a tentative calendar invite now (link below) and mark it as tentative — please accept if the time works or propose an alternative.

Calendar invite (draft): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def

Action items:
- Emma/Liam: confirm core attendees and whether Tereza (security) will join the first session or rotate in Week C.
- Aditya: please attach the 2-slide deployment/perf one-pager you mentioned before EOD Monday PT.
- Marissa: I'll seed the MAP as a shared Drive doc and add the initial owners to milestones.

If you prefer, I can also use a Doodle-style poll for the first three weeks, but the draft invite is the fastest way to lock a slot.

Thanks — looking forward to next week.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP-Aperture-v1.pdf (stated), Aperture-usage-metrics.xlsx (stated)
